SCOPE = the pa-kpi-bento CONTAINER (card shell + header + body/grid + footer) the component emits; the per-KPI tiles come from the sibling kpi_bento_tile/1, fed through the required inner_block slot (dumper renders slot content as plain text), so only container features are mapped here — the .pa-kpi-bento-tile* block is deferred in the oracle fixture. The container has NO block-level modifiers; `layout` is an element modifier on __grid. NOTE: keen's `bento_layout` attr takes underscored values (hero_right/5_tile) but internally dasherizes (_->-), so the oracle's dashed value (hero-right/5-tile) passes through unchanged and produces the same `pa-kpi-bento__grid--{value}` class. `footer` maps to the plain-string `footer_text` attr (not the `footer` slot) so the harness exercises the <span>-wrapped caption shape. The LIVE pill label defaults to 'LIVE' (live_text, unset here). keen's extra `row_height` / `live_text` conveniences are NOT part of the shared oracle container contract and are intentionally omitted.
